scope: All 20 numbered results requested from the attached draft are formalized. Random-limit and channel-existence results use only the explicitly permitted block-modified strong-convergence theorem. Every guide lists the exact declarations, paper hypotheses, and all transitive local Lean sources.

citation.title: Counterexamples to additivity of minimum output p-Rényi entropy of quantum channels for all p ≥ 0

only_permitted_external_assumption: Block-modified strong-convergence theorem (including the limiting free-convolution law), if not formalized.
attachment_note: The supplied BernoulliEdge.lean is retained in repaired, compiled form as SuppliedBernoulliEdge.lean. Its hedge parameter assumes the spectral edge; the final A.1 and II.3 proofs instead derive that edge in RevisionBernoulliHolomorphic and RevisionBernoulliCompression.
corrections: Abstract claims a single pair simultaneously for all positive p; Theorem I.1 proves a pair for each p.
Lemma II.3 must be phrased with a sequence P_n,d_n at fixed k.
In II.3, call I_k tensor A the output-first Choi matrix C_phi; the input-first convention of the preliminaries gives J_phi=A tensor I_k.
Lemma III.3 requires nonempty compact convex sets.
Define m_{k,t}=min_{u in D} sum_i u_i before using it.
In C.1 the Lagrangian multiplier mu/s is fixed at the minimizing point when computing its Hessian.
Appendix C should describe the exact Fraction/log-series Python certificate actually provided, not ordinary mpmath arithmetic as rigorously outward rounded.
The proof certifies k_high(1)<=182, not minimality.

results.title: Full local support of a Haar-random subspace
results.proved_scope: Actual unitary Haar probability measure, projection conjugation, partial-trace rank min(n,k*d), and almost-sure positive-definiteness iff n<=k*d.
paper_assumptions: n,k,d natural, 1<=d<=n*k; P0 Hermitian idempotent of rank d. No external Gaussian/Haar rank premise.

results.title: Random compression formula
results.proved_scope: For an actual projection sequence, affine operator-norm convergence from the permitted amplified block-modified strong-convergence input implies largest-eigenvalue convergence to the stated body support, simultaneously for all real coefficient vectors on one probability-one event. The spectral edge is proved through Lemma A.1.
paper_assumptions: Fixed positive integer k, t in (0,1), rank densities d_n/(n*k)->t, Haar projection sequence.
The source statement incorrectly starts with fixed n,d,P before using d_n,P_n; write a sequence explicitly.

AmplifiedBlockModifiedStrongInput is the permitted block-modified strong-convergence theorem specialized to affine polynomial norm tests on the actual amplified map (id tensor phi_a)(P_n). Tensor operator-norm equality, norm-to-edge conversion, and the edge identity are proved.

results.title: Bernoulli free-convolution spectral edge
results.proved_scope: The rightmost topological support point of an actual compact probability measure with the standard additive Bernoulli R-transform germ equals the stated constrained maximum. The actual Cauchy transform, branch continuation, holomorphic inverse obstruction, and finite/infinite endpoint alternatives are proved.
paper_assumptions: Positive integer k, t in (0,1), every real coefficient vector a.

The free-convolution law is specified by its conventional inverse-Cauchy/additive-R germ (IsBernoulliFreeSumLaw), with existence supplied by the permitted block-modified theorem. No edge identity is a field of that law.

results.title: Hausdorff limit of output state spaces
results.proved_scope: Almost-sure convergence of the actual locally normalized channel output image to the actual unitarily invariant density-matrix body in the genuine trace-norm Hausdorff distance. Compactness, convexity, support identification, general Hermitian tests, common probability-one events, and eventual marginal invertibility including the finite-prefix argument are proved.
paper_assumptions: Fixed k>=2, t in (1/k^2,1), independent Haar projections with d_n/(n*k)->t; channels defined eventually when marginals positive.
FullBlockModifiedStrongInput is the sole external theorem parameter; it contains the norm and weak-trace parts of the permitted block-modified strong-convergence theorem for the same law.

results.title: One-copy entropy limit and asymptotics
results.proved_scope: The actual channel minimum Rényi entropy tends almost surely to the attained minimum on the actual output body. Matrix-entropy continuity, the spectral-body image equality, and the large-k expansion (with stronger O(k^-5/2) error) are proved for every fixed p>0, including p=1.
paper_assumptions: For fixed k, p>0 and assumptions of III.1; for large k, fixed t in (0,1), p>0.

results.title: Support-function formula for trace-norm Hausdorff distance
results.proved_scope: Exact trace-norm Hausdorff distance equals the supremum of support-function differences over the Hermitian operator-norm unit ball. Trace/operator duality is attained by explicit spectral witnesses; compact trace balls and the separation argument are proved.
paper_assumptions: Nonempty compact convex sets C,K of Hermitian k-by-k matrices. The PDF omits nonemptiness and should add it.

results.title: Channel support and generalized-eigenvalue threshold
results.proved_scope: For the actual normalized channel output of Eq. (20), maximization over positive-semidefinite trace-one matrices equals the largest normalized compression eigenvalue, and its infimum threshold is exactly the paper formula. The density eigenstate attaining the maximum and all trace identities are proved.
paper_assumptions: Positive-definite marginal P_A,n and Hermitian H.

results.title: Limit of the Bell output
results.proved_scope: The genuine tensor-product/conjugate-channel Bell output converges almost surely in the matrix operator norm to the explicit isotropic density matrix. Every actual Choi entry, logarithmic potential, second-moment transfer, and polarization step is proved, and the local normalizer is the actual inverse marginal square root with eventual invertibility derived.
paper_assumptions: Fixed k>=2, t in (1/k^2,1), Haar projections with rank density tending to t.

results.title: Product-channel bound and Bell entropy expansion
results.proved_scope: The actual tensor-product/conjugate-channel minimum entropy has limsup at most the explicit Bell-spectrum entropy. The Bell input is proved to be a density matrix, the witness bound and matrix-entropy continuity are proved, and the actual isotropic entropy has the stated expansion with stronger O(k^-4) error, for every p>0 including p=1.
paper_assumptions: For fixed k, assumptions of IV.1 and p>0; asymptotic expansion fixed t in (0,1),p>0.

results.title: Second logarithmic variation
results.proved_scope: Second derivative of the actual probability-measure logarithmic potential, with exactly the stated c0,c1 coefficients. The negative inverse-Cauchy branch, positive support from the proved edge theorem, log-integral identity, implicit root regularity, root uniqueness, and two differentiations are proved.
paper_assumptions: Fixed k>=2, t in (1/k^2,1); every Hermitian H; F(X)=integral log x d mu_X(x).

results.title: Second moments after local normalization
results.proved_scope: The actual normalized Choi-block mixed moments converge to the explicit c0,c1 formula. The scalar logdet limit is derived from weak spectral convergence with a proved spectral gap; uniform finite differences, matrix norm contraction, real/complex polarization, and all common probability-one events are proved. The inverse-square-root normalizer and its eventual identity are instantiated in the canonical Bell theorem.
paper_assumptions: Assumptions of IV.1; all finite indices i,j,p,q.

results.title: Asymptotic second Choi moment
results.proved_scope: The almost-sure limit of the actual normalized full Choi purity is the exact rational coefficient alpha(k,t), for the actual inverse-square-root local normalizer. It follows by summing the proved actual mixed moments.
paper_assumptions: Assumptions of IV.1.

results.title: Single-output and Bell-output asymptotics after antisymmetric postprocessing
results.proved_scope: Both actual fixed-k entropy limits and both actual large-k entropy expansions are assembled for the genuine CP/TP antisymmetric postprocessed channels. Fixed-k existence holds for every k>=r with k^2*t>1. The actual body minimum and actual postprocessed Bell matrix have the stated coefficients, with stronger O(k^-5/2) and O(k^-3) errors respectively, for all fixed p>0 including p=1.
paper_assumptions: Fixed integer r>=1,t in (0,1),p>0; for each k>=r with k^2*t>1 take n->infinity first, then k->infinity.

In the final Lean wrappers, parameter r represents the paper particle count r+1, covering every positive integer particle count. The weighted Bell spectrum is used only in the eventually valid range k>=2(r+1).

results.title: Eigenvalue shuffling
results.proved_scope: For every actual Hermitian input matrix, an explicit basis of the actual alternating tensor subspace diagonalizes antisymmetric postprocessing with exactly the subset-sum eigenvalues AppendixB.shuffle. The signed permutation projector, Slater basis, completeness, change of basis, channel coefficient, and dimension binomial(k,r) are all proved. The fixed Slater-coordinate matrix map is proved completely positive and trace preserving, and is explicitly conjugate to the restricted tensor operator.
paper_assumptions: Hermitian X, integer 1<=r<=k; spectrum counted with r-subset multiplicities.

results.title: Entropy of the one-channel output body after antisymmetric postprocessing
results.proved_scope: The actual antisymmetric postprocessed matrix-body entropy image equals the explicit shuffle image. Its attained minimum has the exact leading coefficient and O(k^-5/2) error for every fixed p>0. Actual CP/TP, a unitary spectral decomposition, the normalized feasible body, all Taylor bounds, sharp quadratic optimization, and minimum attainment are proved.
paper_assumptions: Fixed t in (0,1), p>0, integer r>=1, k->infinity.

results.title: Entropy of the limiting Bell output after antisymmetric postprocessing
results.proved_scope: The actual tensor-postprocessed isotropic Bell matrix has exactly the weighted dm/bellNu entropy formula. Its Kraus representation, antisymmetric partial-trace recurrence, surjectivity, complete eigenvalue multiplicities, matrix normalization, and spectral regrouping are proved. The actual matrix entropy has O(k^-3) error for every fixed r and p>0; the unprocessed r=1 estimate improves to O(k^-4).
paper_assumptions: Fixed t in (0,1),p>0,r>=1; operator Z is the isotropic state of IV.1; sufficient k>=2r in spectral proof.
Some finite-operator helper modules use the Lean parameter r for paper particle number r+1; all positive integer particle numbers are covered.

results.title: Nonadditivity for every positive Renyi order
results.proved_scope: For every real p>0, actual finite-dimensional complex-linear CP/TP channels Phi and conjugate Phi are constructed with strict nonadditivity of their actual minimum output Renyi entropies. The concrete independent Haar ensemble, finite-index choice, channel normalization, antisymmetric postprocessing, spectra, continuity, entropy limits, Bell witness bound, and conjugate-minimum equality are all proved. The only external input is CanonicalStrongInput, the permitted strong-convergence theorem on that explicit ensemble.
paper_assumptions: For each real p>0. Channels and dimensions may depend on p. Choice r=5,t=1/376 in checked spectral proof.

results.title: Certified output dimension 182
results.proved_scope: The exact paper inequality 477/10^6 < 2 min_{rho in K_182,t} S1(rho) − S1(Bell spectrum) is proved for the actual matrix output body, with attained minimum. All shape and numerical premises are discharged. It certifies k_high(1)<=182 and does not assert minimality. The accompanying finite-channel theorem derives eventual nonadditivity for the actual product/conjugate channels from the same permitted convergence input.

results.title: Reduction of the entropy minimum
results.proved_scope: Every minimizer on the actual normalized feasible body has one strictly higher coordinate and equal remaining coordinates. The attained minimum equals h_k(L*) and gives the lower bound for every certified L. Compact minimization, boundary exclusion (including the quartic case), Lagrange multipliers, two-value reduction, and the explicit feasible negative-curvature perturbation are proved under the general paper hypotheses.

results.title: Scalar certificate for the largest eigenvalue
results.proved_scope: The arbitrary-dimension Lemma C.2 implication for the actual Lam body, including derived positive mass under k^2*t>1, is checked; q_paper_formula identifies the paper radicand. This is stronger than the paper because 0<L<1 is unnecessary.
paper_assumptions: Ambient k>=2,t in (1/k^2,1) so normalized body has positive mass; 0<L<1,z>=0,U_{k,t}(L,z)<=0.

assumption_interface.meaning: The same Bernoulli free-sum law governs amplified polynomial-norm tests and weak empirical spectral averages. All spectral edges, logarithmic potentials, normalized moments, matrix spectra, entropies, and strict gaps are derived.
assumption_interface.free_convolution_representation: Free convolution is represented analytically by its standard additive inverse-Cauchy/R-transform germ. The permitted strong-convergence input supplies this law. No separate abstract C*-algebraic construction of free additive convolution or its R-additivity theorem is claimed.
